about.text: Meta description: "Professional-grade League of Legends tools: tactical maps, draft simulator, scrim analytics, player stats, and team management. Built for competitive players and coaches."

OpenRift: free platform for the amateur League scene: team dashboard and roster, scrim scheduling, scrim replay analytics (.rofl upload or review form), champion pool and draft simulator with live meta, public team pages and player profiles, 'find players for open lanes', roles for solo players, teams, coaches and multi-team structures; 'Free for the amateur scene. Always.'
